name: Coromandel International Limited
summary: Coromandel International Limited provides agriculture solutions in India and internationally. The company operates through the Nutrient and Other Allied Business, and Crop Protection segments. It offers crop nutrition products, including fertilizers, specialty nutrients, organic, and nano products; crop protection products comprising insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, and GPS products; and other bio products. It also provides drone spray services, as well as soil and leaf testing services.
